title.en: Fable 5 — The Fox and the Stork

sentences.en: The fox invited the stork to lunch.
He said: come tomorrow.
I have good soup.

words.caphi_raw: sh oo r a b e

sentences.en: The stork was glad.
And came the next day.
And the fox put the soup in a plate.

words.caphi_raw: sh oo r a b e

sentences.en: A flat, wide plate.
The fox ate with his tongue.
He licked, and licked, and was full.
And the stork tried.
His beak is long.

sentences.en: He could not eat from the plate.
And the fox said: you do not like the soup?

words.caphi_raw: sh oo r a b e

sentences.en: And laughed.
And the stork went home hungry.
Two days later, the stork invited the fox.
He said: come tomorrow.
I have good fish.

And the stork put the fish in a jar.
